products.title: Bamboozle Nappy Wrap - Totsbots
products.body_html:
The perfect nappy covers to use with the either our Bamboozle nappies or the smaller Bamboozle pads for daytime, use or over the top of the Bamboozle Stretch night-time nappy for up to 12 hours absorbency. With NEW hidden hook and loop tabs for better comfort on chubby bellies and with tuck under pockets to keep the day time pads in place.

Adjustable poppers in the rise means the bamboozle nappy covers will fit every nappy and every bum beautifully. Made in the UK using fabric woven from yarn derived from post consumer plast waste, you can reduce reuse and recycle one nappy change at at a time!

TOP TIP: If the wrap isn't soiled, you can simply wipe down after a change and reuse with your next nappy. You will typically need a ratio of 1 wrap to 4 Bamboozles.

products.title: Preorder Mattress Protector (40 Oz!)
products.body_html:
The peace-of-mind addition to your PJs!

When used together with our patented Peejamas, our mattress protector provides a whopping 50+ oz. of absorbency making it the perfect extra layer of comfort (literally and figuratively) for kids who are heavy wetters, just getting started on their potty-training journey, or even those who manage the challenges of ongoing incontinence.

These updated boosters add powerful absorbency without bulk, helping your child stay comfortable and dry all night long.

Simply snap the booster insert directly into your child’s Peejamas or Training Pants before bedtime. When paired with Nighttime Jammies (which hold ~10 oz of urine), these inserts can increase absorbency by 40%!

  • Care Instructions: Pre-wash at least 3 times before first use to maximize absorbency.
